title: The Optimal Ranking Tradeoffs Between Two Ranking Scores in Two-Class Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.23294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class precision), class-specific intersections over unions, class-specific F-scores, Cohen's kappa, and balanced accuracy are scores that one intuitively wants to maximize when developing machine learning methods. However, they lead to different rankings of such methods. So, how can we establish a ranking that is an optimal tradeoff between any pair of these scores? It turns out that all these scores are special cases of ranking scores: a continuum of scores parameterized by the relative importance values assigned to the true negative, false positive, false negative, and true positive outcomes. translated_title: 两类分类中两个排序得分之间的最优排序权衡
translated_abstract: 准确率、真负例率（负类召回率）、真正例率（正类召回率）、负预测值（负类精确率）、正预测值（正类精确率）、类别特定的交并比、类别特定的F分数、Cohen's kappa系数以及平衡准确率，都是人们在开发机器学习方法时直观上希望最大化的评分指标。然而，这些指标会导致对这些方法的不同排序。那么，我们如何建立一种在这些指标中任意两者之间实现最优权衡的排序呢？事实证明，所有这些指标都是排序得分（ranking scores）的特例：这是一种由分配给真负例、假正例、假负例和真正例结果的相对重要性值所参数化的连续评分体系。由于所有这些指标都已知能产生有意义的排序，我们寻求它们之间的最优权衡。我们将两个得分之间的权衡视为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了常用的二分类评估指标都是同一参数化排序得分族的特例，并据此建立了两类分类中任意两个排序得分之间的最优权衡排序方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that common classification evaluation metrics are special cases of a parameterized family of ranking scores, and establishes optimal tradeoff rankings between any pair of such scores in two-class classification.
